newsitem.title: FRANCE: ALPINE SKIING-TOMBA INTENDING TO RACE SUNDAY'S SLALOM.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-TOMBA INTENDING TO RACE SUNDAY'S SLALOM.

text.p: World Alpine skiing champion Alberto Tomba is in Chamonix where he should take part in a World Cup slalom on Sunday, his ski manufacturer said on Thursday.

"He's there and he didn't train today (Thursday) but he should train tomorrow (Friday) and he intends to race the slalom," a spokeswoman for the ski manufacturer said. "He would not be in Chamonix otherwise."

Some doubt had been cast on his participation with a report on Wednesday that the triple Olympic gold medallist had halted training in Italy after a flare-up of pain in the wrist which he injured in a fall in October.
